statement.p: The points (3,5)\text{,} (5,6)\text{,} (7,7)\text{,} and (9,8) all lie on a straight line. What can go wrong if you make a plot of a Cartesian plane with these points marked, and you dont have tick marks that are evenly spaced apart?

solution.p: Answers will vary, but the issue is that having irregularly spaced tick marks can make it so that points that are actually in a straight line might not appear to be in a straight line.
